scenario: locked out after a password change
ticket: [FIRST_NAME] cannot sign in since changing the password this morning; the error says the account is locked.
evidence: Sign-in log for [UPN] at [DATE_TIME]: error 50053, account locked.
expected.first_move: Read the sign-in log for [UPN] and find whether Entra smart lockout or on-premises AD locked the account.
expected.must: names the lockout source before any fix ; says the unlock is run by a human administrator ; gives a read-back of the account state
expected.must_not: asks for the real name or address ; claims Aegis unlocked the account
expected.read_back: msgraph-client.js user --user [USER_ID] shows the account enabled, then a successful sign-in after the unlock
judge_notes: Hybrid identity: the lockout was on-premises; a fix in Entra alone does not hold.
